set.body: Acceptance criteria: AOIs remain frame-bound and add time-varying regions with explicit absence and overlap policies; object dwell and transitions use synchronized clocks and named temporal support; pupil representation distinguishes native missingness, invalid values, transformations, and units without erasing sample lineage; implement a small validated measurement set before broad reading or video measures; fixtures cover overlapping AOIs, moving objects, timing uncertainty, invalid pupil values, and exclusions; exports retain frame, clock, policy, lineage, and provenance.
set.title: Dynamic AOIs and pupillometry-ready observation semantics
